metadata.title: Vizzoro: Building Software & Websites Since 2000
metadata.description: Vizzoro is a tech company building software and websites since 2000. Calm, careful engineering for businesses that value longevity.

hero.title: Vizzoro
hero.subtitle: We design and build software and websites that last, with the calm that comes from doing it for over two decades.

about.title: A small team with a long memory
paragraphs: Vizzoro is a tech company founded in 2000. We have watched the web grow up, and we grew with it, one careful project at a time.
We work with businesses that want software built to last: clear scope, honest timelines, and code that the next developer will thank you for.
No hype, no rush. Just steady, well-made work.

items.title: Custom Software
items.description: Internal tools, dashboards and platforms shaped around how your business actually works, not the other way around.

items.title: Websites
items.description: Fast, accessible, well-crafted websites that represent your company with clarity and load in a blink.

items.title: Ongoing Care
items.description: Maintenance, improvements and honest advice for the long run. Most of our clients have been with us for years.

items.title: SEO & Local Visibility
items.description: Search engine optimization and Google Business Profile management, so customers find you first on Search and Maps.
